Five Star Omakase
Dec 2024 • Couples
We had the Omakase on Dec 31, 2024 and it was amazing. My partner and I are both allergic to shellfish but the kitchen was great with accommodating us and editing the menu to suit. 

We also did the sake pairing and their sommelier came by to pour each glass himself and provide great information about the sake. 

The price is a lot for Vietnam but very good if you’re comparing similar quality Omakase in the US. We spent a wonderful 3 hours at this restaurant enjoying our meal.

Delicous summer omakase menu at FUME
Jun 2024 • Friends
FUME serves an omakase courses with the freshest and high-quality ingredients. Chef Shozo and his team’s skills and technique can be found in every exquisite detail of every dish, to create the sublime dining experience of specially-curated delicacies.

The Early Summer Omakase with 7 courses of a variety of sashimi as well as warayaki, tempura, wan, aroma of kemuri, charcold grilled and desserts. We paired it with a bottle of Morishima Yamadanishiki Junmaiginjo Sake that was refreshing and perfect for this meal.
Highly recommend adding FUME to your list next

An absolute must while visiting Ho Chi Min City! A truly unforgettable evening.
Dec 2023 • Couples
An Absolutely incredible evening at Fume. Highly recommend this place for outstanding quality food and Japanese immersion experience! 

This place was recommended to us and it totally exceeded our expectations. This restaurant deserves a few Michelin stars rating! The food is super fresh, incredibly presented, staff is very knowledgeable and the service is outstanding. The sommelier is very knowledgeable about both wines and sakes and recommended an excellent sake pairing to our dinner. This place is a must during your visit to Ho Chi Min City. Reservation is a must.

Overprice. No taste. Bad service.
Aug 2020
Very bad experience in Saigon at Fume.
Fume is all about fashionable instagram foodies.

We left Fume being angry and HUNGRY. 
There is not taste, and service is not professional (which restaurant clean their windows at 8:30pm when you have clients ?)

After paying more than 60 usd / pax, we expect to have good value for money. But only very small portion, and absolutely no taste in the plate.

I shared my feedback directly to the chef, he really doesn't care.
I shared my feedback to the owner, he doesn't care.

At least you know : only a business, not a restaurant.
